svg.title: Cold-Chain Logistics AI Assistant: system architecture
svg.desc: A dispatcher asks a question in a Streamlit chat. A LangGraph ReAct agent picks a tool. The SQL tool reads a read-only view on SQL Server running in Docker on a separate EC2 node. The SOP tool searches Pinecone. Every step is written to an append-only audit table. Build-time pipelines load the CSV and the SOP documents.
svg.text: A dispatcher asks in plain English. The agent answers from live telemetry and the current SOP, and the database never trusts the model.
The deeper the data, the tighter the access
